name: What types of doors are best for wheelchair access?

mainEntity.name: What types of doors are best for wheelchair access?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common options include swing doors with wider openings, pocket doors, and barn doors. Swing doors are practical but require clear space for opening and closing. Pocket doors slide into a wall cavity, saving space but can be more complex to install. Barn doors slide along the wall, offering good accessibility and a unique aesthetic, but may not seal as tightly as other door types. Your choice often depends on available space and desired functionality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Best doors for wheelchair access include wider swing doors, pocket doors, and barn doors, each offering different space-saving and functional benefits.
